name: TensorPlatform IMO MSC.137(76) Manoeuvrability Compliance (wind-current-ice coupled MMG, VLCC/KVLCC2)

vessel.description: Vessel particulars (L, B, T, Cb, rudder area, propeller diameter); default data.VESSEL_VLCC

coefficient_sets.description: Named MMG derivative sets to audit; the verdict must agree across all of them

results.description: Per coefficient set: C1-C4 criteria with value / limit / margin / pass / borderline flags

overall_passed.description: True only if every criterion passes for every set

coefficient_set_robust.description: True if all sets agree, making the verdict independent of the derivative choice

absolute_accuracy_claim.description: Always WITHHELD - no EFD manoeuvring baseline is available offline

applicability.regime: Calm-water 3-DOF manoeuvring; statutory minimum-manoeuvrability verdict for ships >= 100 m. Wind/current/ice loads available in the parent module but not used by the standards audit (IMO trials are calm-water).

failure_modes.symptom: C4 first overshoot 26.49 deg (kvlcc2_reference) and 29.15 deg (slender_body) exceed the 25 deg statutory limit
failure_modes.mitigation: Calibrate the MMG derivative set against Z-test data before any regulatory-compliance use; treat C4 verdicts as model-capability diagnostics only

failure_modes.mode: Wrong L/V branch selected for C3
failure_modes.symptom: applying the 10 deg limit to a long slow ship (L/V = 41.5 s here) fails a compliant hull
failure_modes.mitigation: overshoot_limit_deg() returns the branch explicitly and every result carries branch/LV_s

failure_modes.symptom: NaN or infinite metric compared against a limit
failure_modes.mitigation: _check() fails any non-finite value and records 'value not finite, cannot certify'

failure_modes.symptom: reading a 40 % margin below the limit as 40 % modelling accuracy
failure_modes.mitigation: absolute_accuracy_claim is hard-wired to WITHHELD and the withheld reasons are enumerated in output

failure_modes.symptom: stopping ability and course keeping silently treated as passing
